name: Dependants' Protection Scheme leaflet — premium rate table (public CPF material)
note: This page is a PREMIUM table, not a benefit schedule. Its left column is age bands. Reading it as cover would tell the household that being 35-39 pays them S$30, so the fixture asserts those rows are never produced.
